# Local Spagbol package

This unpublished 0.1.0 tarball is produced by Spagbol's Docker build and `pack:local` script. It includes the compiled public API, type declarations and source maps. It is a committed input to Teia's npm/Docker builds; no sibling checkout or package registry access to Spagbol is required.

The package archive and its integrity entry in the root lockfile must be refreshed together. See the shared graph UI section in the root README. Teia intentionally uses the controlled canvas primitives; its own graph controller and renderers remain responsible for patch semantics.
